connector.name: MCP by skopik.com
connector.registryDescription: Your org's AI agents, tasks, runs, search, and brain files as MCP tools and resources.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.skopik.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.skopik, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SKOPIK_API_KEY
env.description: Skopik API key or user access token.

env.name: SKOPIK_API_URL
env.description: Skopik API base URL. Set to https://api.skopik.com for production.
